name: Nusantara Rent
desc_id: Rental mobil dengan driver yang beroperasi lintas kota. Tantangannya: rentang armada dari Avanza keluarga sampai Alphard tamu VVIP harus terbaca dalam satu layar tanpa membuat calon penyewa merasa salah alamat. Saya susun hierarki gelap-keemasan yang menaruh kapasitas dan harga di muka, lalu memangkas jalur booking menjadi satu langkah ke WhatsApp.
desc_en: A car rental service with drivers operating across cities. The challenge: a fleet spanning family Avanzas to VVIP Alphards had to read clearly in one screen without making anyone feel they were in the wrong place. I built a dark-and-gold hierarchy that leads with capacity and price, then cut the booking path down to a single step into WhatsApp.
